description: This Java class 'SimpleServiceEngine' implements a service engine for executing services synchronously within the Apache OFBiz framework. It extends 'GenericAsyncEngine' and provides methods to run services either returning results or ignoring them, utilizing a helper method 'serviceInvoker' to invoke service methods based on 'ModelService' metadata.

classes.name: SimpleServiceEngine
classes.description: The main class acting as a service engine that invokes simple, static service methods based on provided service metadata.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a specified service synchronously and returns a map of results, throwing exception if the service does not return expected results.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a specified service synchronously, ignoring the returned results.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Private helper method to invoke a static service method specified in the 'ModelService' object, handling class loading and exceptions.
